title: Factions
subtitle: Teams, territory, chat, and live leaderboards (WebSocket). Requires PostgreSQL login.
needAuthBody: Sign in with NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL so factions sync to your account.
createHint: You become leader. Tag is 2–4 letters/numbers.
joinHint: Paste an invite code from your leader.
chatHint: Realtime messages for your faction room.
territoryHint: Canvas id + grid cell. Wire your canvas to the same API or socket.
captchaRequired: Verify you’re human to continue claiming (Cloudflare Turnstile).
placementLocked: Placements are temporarily restricted on this account.
